rows.summary: The customer was unexpectedly charged twice for their monthly subscription this morning and is asking for a fix.
rows.formal:
Hello,

We understand that you noticed two identical charges on your account this morning for your monthly subscription. Please be assured that we will investigate both transaction IDs and issue a full refund for the duplicate billing error. We appreciate your patience while we resolve this matter for you.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic:
It's completely understandable that seeing two identical charges for your subscription this morning is frustrating, and I'm sorry for the confusion. We're going to check both transaction IDs and we will issue a full refund for the duplicate charge. Thank you for bringing this to our attention so we can fix it for you.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.short: We will review your transaction IDs and issue a full refund for the duplicate charge on your account.

rows.summary: The customer was charged $59.99 yesterday after forgetting to cancel their annual plan free trial. They are requesting a full refund.
rows.formal:
Hello,

We understand that you are requesting a refund for the annual plan charge of $59.99 that occurred yesterday following your trial period. Please be advised that you are eligible for a refund under our policy provided that the first charge happened less than 7 days ago and the application was not used after the charge. We will review your account details against these criteria to process your request. 

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic:
It is totally understandable that you are upset about the unexpected charge after forgetting to cancel your trial. We are here to help you with your refund request for the $59.99 annual plan charge. You will be eligible for a refund as long as the first charge happened less than 7 days ago and you haven't used the app since that charge occurred. We will look into this for you right away.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.short: You are eligible for a refund for the annual plan charge if it occurred less than 7 days ago and you have not used the app since. We will review your account and process the refund accordingly.

rows.summary: The customer is unable to log into their account because the magic link email has not arrived despite multiple attempts. They want to receive the login link to access their account.
rows.formal:
Hello,

We understand that you are experiencing difficulties receiving the magic link email to access your account. Please review your spam and promotions folders, as corporate mail filters occasionally block these messages. Additionally, please note that links expire after fifteen minutes and only the most recent link remains active. If the issue persists, please reply with your device model, operating system version, and application version so we can escalate the matter to our technical support team.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic: It can be really frustrating when you're trying to sign in and the login email just won't show up after multiple tries. Please check your spam and promotions folders, keeping in mind that corporate mail filters can sometimes block our messages. Also, remember that links expire after 15 minutes and only the newest link will work. If you still can't sign in after checking these things, please let us know your device model, OS version, and app version so we can escalate this to our tech support team.
rows.short: Please check your spam folder, noting that links expire after 15 minutes and only the latest one works. If you still cannot sign in, please reply with your device model, OS version, and app version.

human_reasons: Possible expert misconduct: Expert Quality reviews the transcript, do not promise an outcome.
rows.summary: The customer is upset because an astrologer named Elena was rude and advised them to leave their husband. The customer wants to report this unacceptable behavior.
rows.formal:
Hello,

Thank you for bringing this situation to our attention. We take reports regarding expert conduct very seriously, especially concerning inappropriate advice during a session. Please be advised that your complaint has been escalated to our Expert Quality team for a thorough review of the chat transcript. Our team will carefully examine the details within 48 hours. We kindly ask for your patience while this matter is being reviewed.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic:
It is completely understandable that you're upset and hurt after receiving such harsh and inappropriate advice from your astrologer. We're truly sorry you had this negative experience. Your complaint is being escalated to our Expert Quality team, who will review the chat transcript within 48 hours. We appreciate your patience while we look into this matter further.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.short: Your complaint has been escalated to our Expert Quality team, who will review the chat transcript within 48 hours.

human_reasons: Personal-data request (GDPR): only the Privacy team can action it.
Legal or privacy matter: route to Legal & Privacy, agent must not commit to anything.
rows.summary: The customer wants to have their account and all personal data deleted in accordance with GDPR. They are requesting account deletion.
rows.formal:
Hello,

We have received your request regarding the deletion of your account and personal data in accordance with GDPR regulations. Please be advised that requests submitted to customer support are forwarded to our dedicated Privacy team for processing. The Privacy team will complete your request within 30 days as required by GDPR guidelines. We will notify you once your case has been fully reviewed and addressed.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic:
Hello, I completely understand how important it is to have control over your personal information and privacy. Your request to delete your account and data under GDPR has been received. Support will forward your details to our Privacy team, who will handle and complete your request within 30 days. We are currently reviewing your case and will make sure everything is taken care of properly.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.short: Your account deletion request under GDPR has been forwarded to our Privacy team and will be completed within 30 days. We are currently reviewing your case.

human_reasons: Possible self-harm or threat of violence: escalate to Trust & Safety, do not send a template.
rows.summary: The customer expressed suicidal ideation and hopelessness influenced by their horoscope reading. They are experiencing a mental health crisis.
rows.formal:
Hello,

We understand that you are going through a difficult time and experiencing intense distress. Please know that you are not alone and that help is available to you right now. Because your message indicates that you may be in crisis, we have escalated your case to our Trust and Safety team for careful review. Additionally, we strongly encourage you to reach out to local emergency services or contact the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline immediately for professional support. Our team will follow up with you as soon as possible regarding this review.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic: It sounds like you're carrying an unbearable weight right now, and I'm so sorry you're feeling this hopeless. Your safety and well-being matter deeply, and you don't have to navigate this pain by yourself. Since you're going through such a critical moment, I've escalated your case to our Trust and Safety team for a careful review. Please reach out to local emergency services or call the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline right away to get the immediate support you deserve. Our team will review your case and follow up with you soon.
rows.short: We are reviewing your case with our Trust and Safety team. Please reach out to local emergency services or the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline immediately for support.

rows.summary: The customer noticed a double charge for their subscription and is requesting a refund for the extra payment.
rows.formal:
Вітаємо!

Ми отримали ваше звернення щодо подвійного списання коштів за підписку. Наші спеціалісти перевірять обидва номери транзакцій та здійснять повне повернення зайвого платежу. Будь ласка, очікуйте на результати перевірки.

З повагою, команда Nebula
rows.empathetic:
Прикро чути, що ви зіткнулися з проблемою подвійного списання коштів за підписку. Ми обов'язково перевіримо обидва номери транзакцій і повернемо вам зайвий платіж у повному обсязі. Дякуємо за ваше терпіння, поки ми розв'язуємо це питання.

З повагою, команда Nebula
rows.short: Ми перевіримо номери транзакцій у системі та повернемо кошти за дублюючий платіж.

rows.summary: The customer made a mistake during registration and wants to know how to change their birth date in their profile.
rows.formal:
Hola,

Puede modificar su fecha de nacimiento directamente en la aplicación. Para ello, debe abrir la sección de perfil, seleccionar los datos personales y editar su fecha, hora o lugar de nacimiento. Tenga en cuenta que estos datos se pueden cambiar hasta tres veces al mes para prevenir el uso indebido de las lecturas gratuitas. Su carta natal y sus horóscopos se recalcularán pocos minutos después de realizar la modificación.

Atentamente,
Nebula Support
rows.empathetic:
Entiendo perfectamente que te equivoques al registrarte y quieras tener tu carta natal correcta. No te preocupes, puedes actualizar tu fecha de nacimiento tú misma abriendo tu perfil, yendo a la sección de datos personales y editando la información. Recuerda que puedes modificar estos datos hasta tres veces al mes, y tu carta natal junto con los horóscopos se recalcularán en unos pocos minutos.

Un saludo,
Nebula Support
rows.short: Para cambiar tu fecha de nacimiento, ve a Perfil > Datos personales y edítala. Puedes realizar este cambio hasta 3 veces al mes, y tu carta natal se actualizará en unos minutos.

rows.summary: The customer cancelled their subscription, but was charged again anyway, and is accusing the company of fraud. They want a resolution and likely a refund for the unexpected charge.
rows.formal:
Guten Tag,

wir bedauern sehr, dass Ihnen nach einer bereits bestätigten Kündigung erneut Betrag abgebucht wurde. Wir prüfen den Vorfall sorgfältig für Sie und erstatten die entsprechende Zahlung, sofern die Voraussetzungen erfüllt sind. Bitte teilen Sie uns hierzu die notwendigen Details mit. Wir danken Ihnen für Ihre Geduld während der Bearbeitung Ihres Anliegens.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic:
Hallo,

ich kann absolut verstehen, wie ärgerlich und besorgniserregend es ist, wenn nach einer Kündigung unerwartet Geld abgebucht wird. Entschuldigen Sie bitte diese Unannehmlichkeiten. Wir werden die Situation umgehend für Sie untersuchen und Ihnen die betroffene Gebühr erstatten, sobald wir Ihre Kündigungsbestätigung vorliegen haben. Bitte lassen Sie uns diese einfach zukommen, damit wir Ihnen schnellstmöglich weiterhelfen können.

Viele Grüße, Nebula Support
rows.short: Es tut uns leid wegen der unerwarteten Abbuchung nach Ihrer Kündigung. Bitte senden Sie uns Ihre Kündigungsbestätigung, damit wir die Erstattung veranlassen können.

rows.summary: The customer is experiencing a white screen and the birth chart (natal chart) is not loading. They are asking what to do to fix this issue.
rows.formal:
Вітаємо!

Ми розуміємо, що ви зіткнулися з проблемою під час завантаження натальної карти. Для вирішення цього питання оновіть застосунок до найновішої версії, перезавантажте ваш телефон та переконайтеся, що на пристрої є щонайменше 1 ГБ вільної пам'яті. Також білий екран під час відкриття натальної карти зазвичай можна усунути за допомогою очищення кешу на Android або перевстановлення застосунку на iOS. Якщо проблема не зникне після виконання цих дій, будь ласка, повідомте нам модель вашого пристрою, версію операційної системи та версію застосунку.

З повагою, команда Nebula
rows.empathetic:
Привіт!

Ми шкодуємо, що ви бачите лише білий екран замість вашої натальної карти, і розуміємо, як це дратує, коли не виходить скористатися сервісом. Спробуйте оновити програму до найсвіжішої версії, перезавантажити телефон і перевірити, чи є у вас принаймні 1 ГБ вільного місця. Зазвичай білий екран при відкритті натальної карти зникає після очищення кешу для Android або перевстановлення для iOS. Якщо це не допоможе і проблема повториться, напишіть нам модель вашого пристрою, версію ОС та версію програми, щоб ми могли передати деталі до технічної підтримки.
rows.short: Оновіть застосунок, перезавантажте телефон і звільніть щонайменше 1 ГБ пам'яті. Очистіть кеш на Android або перевстановіть застосунок на iOS, а якщо це не допоможе, надішліть нам модель пристрою та версію ОС.

rows.summary: The customer is frustrated because they paid for a personal reading and received a generic, copy-pasted text that their friend also received. They are dissatisfied with the service.
rows.formal:
Hello,

We understand that receiving a reading that matches another customer's experience is disappointing. Paid personal readings are written specifically for your chart, and identical paid readings indicate a content error. We will escalate this matter to the Content team and process a refund for that reading. The refunded amount will be returned to your original payment method. Please note that financial institutions typically reflect the funds within 5–10 business days.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic: I am so sorry you received a generic reading that your friend got too, especially since you paid for something personal and unique. You deserve to get what you paid for, and I completely understand your frustration. Since identical paid readings are a content error, we will escalate this to our Content team and issue you a refund for the reading. The money will go back to your original payment method, and banks usually show it within 5–10 business days.
rows.short: We are sorry for the identical readings. We will escalate this content error and issue a refund to your original payment method, which will appear within 5–10 business days.

human_reasons: Amount above $100: refund requires Billing specialist approval.
A minor is involved: refunds are reviewed case by case by Billing.
rows.summary: The customer's minor daughter used their credit card to purchase $150 worth of credits in the app without authorization. The customer wants a refund for this purchase.
rows.formal:
Hello,

We understand your concern regarding the purchase made by your minor daughter. Please note that Nebula is intended for users who are 18 years of age and older. Because this request involves a purchase made by a minor and exceeds standard agent approval limits, your case is currently being reviewed by our team. We will examine the details of your situation and follow up with you regarding the status of your request. Thank you for your patience during this process.

Best regards, Nebula Support
rows.empathetic:
Hi,

It can be so stressful when unauthorized charges happen, especially when it involves your child using your card. We're truly sorry you're dealing with this situation. Since purchases made by minors require special handling and are reviewed on a case-by-case basis, your case has been escalated for review. Our team will carefully look into your request, and we'll be in touch as soon as we have an update for you.
rows.short: Your request regarding the purchase made by a minor is currently being reviewed by our team. We will follow up with you once the review is complete.

human_reasons: No relevant KB article: the drafts cannot be checked against policy, write the answer yourself.

It is wonderful that you are thinking of ways to make your time on the app even more comfortable, and we totally understand how a dark mode would be great for your eyes. Thank you so much for sharing this thoughtful idea with us. We'll pass your suggestion along to our team to look into for future updates.
